title: Fooyre Ambition Mawnde
intro: Eɓɓoore ngam udditde sifaa dental ngal peeje mum cuuɗiiɗe kawri e joofnirde nde sikkaano, doole. Ndee ɗoo tinndinoore ina waɗi siftorde luggiɗnde e doole Alla e ŋakkeende doole aduna so ina luurdi e ko selli. Uddit sirlu ndee fedde, nde daartol mum winndaa e nder Quraana, jeertinaango wonande kala yiɗɓe ƴattaade.
clues: Min njooɗiima e yiɗde mawnde, min cikki doole amen ngalaa ɗo kaaɗi, min njalti e yah-ngartaa e faandaare laaɓtunde, halkoore.
Ardiiɗo men, keewɗo mawnikinaare, yiɗiino softinde Galle ceniɗo mo heewɓe teddini, fawaade e yiɗde waylude hijjoore e mbaydi ndi min mahi.
Gila e leydi woɗɗundi, min njahi e doole mawɗe, min ngoongɗini mbaawka amen ustude mahdi ɓooyndi e nder wuro ceniingo.
Konu amen ina hulɓinii, ina ardii tagooje mawɗe, ko huunde nde hoɗɓe e leydi ndi min njippii ndii ina famɗi, so tawii ina meeɗi, seedtaade e kampaañ hono oo.
Nde min njottii ɗo min njogori yahde ɗoo, ko jokkere enɗam waɗi; tagooje tokoose, baawɗe baagal peeñi, ina mberloo en e kaaƴe loope ɓuuɓɗe.
Jaɓɓungal amen fof hawri ko e joofnirde bonnde, acci doole amen kulɓiniiɗe ɗee mbonni haa laaɓi, no huɗo ɓuuɓngo nii, peeje amen mawɗe ɗee ustiima haa laaɓi.
arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
verse: Have you not considered, [O Muḥammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant? (105:1)
